contexts.text: It is the nature of evil to want to harass everyone...
That all who harass these simple ones are cast into Hell. Signified.
As it is they who are speaking, it is not said, who infest, but who harass; for the evil excuse and make light of their evil.
Magical arts... by which they harass and infest all who do not honour them.
To assail his name with abuse.
Whom they endeavour to harass in their sleep.
One who had taken delight in provoking others, and in drawing them on to make angry replies.
By many harassments... he had opened to himself the Hells which punish.
Such is the fate of those who... harass, and do violence and evil to others.
When they do this, they thereby assail the Divine.
They harass them from the rocks in many ways... and whithersoever they flee, they pursue them with their eyes, and harass them.
They are so harassed that they can no longer endure it.
An evil Spirit... by such means, harassed me exceedingly.
Thus do they mutually harass each other in Hell.
